links.outcome: Recognition of emergent (Red) gynecologic oncology symptoms in triage vignettes
links.effect: All three LLMs achieved 100% concordance with the reference standard for all Red cases across both treatment groups, with no high-acuity case downgraded to self-care.
links.quote: All three LLMs achieved 100% concordance with the reference standard for all Red cases across both treatment groups, with no high-acuity case downgraded to self-care.

links.outcome: Missed versus unnecessary escalation in LLM triage of vignettes
links.effect: No under-triage of Red cases, but over-triage of intermediate-risk complaints toward immediate or same-day evaluation in the combined group; low-risk complaints showed more variable over-triage.
links.quote: In the combined group, all LLMs over-triaged intermediate-risk complaints toward immediate or same-day evaluation; low-risk complaints showed more variable over-triage.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance on 20 fictitious gynecologic oncology triage vignettes against UKONS reference standards without comparing specific organizational deployment practices or safeguards.
